assets.name: land-texture
assets.label: Land fill
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production raster map element for Transport Dispatch, Miniature World. True orthographic 90-degree top down bird’s-eye view, no side perspective or horizon. Small hand-painted gouache miniature with fine subtle paper grain, slate blue, sage, muted brick and honey accents, restrained clean silhouette and contrast. No words, letters, numbers, trademarks or watermark. One square opaque full-bleed material swatch of warm muted sage grass and tiny irregular dry earth grain. Very low contrast and no distinct objects. Even density and color across all edges. This lies behind the entire randomized top-down town map. Absolutely no roads, shapes, scenery, hills, horizon or light hotspots.
